title: Deep learning for de-convolution of Smad2 versus Smad3 binding sites.
authors: Ng, Jeremy W K; Ong, Esther H Q; Tucker-Kellogg, Lisa; Tucker-Kellogg, Greg
one_liner_zh: 该文用CNN-LSTM深度学习模型区分Smad2与Smad3的ChIP-seq结合位点，聚焦转录因子DNA结合特异性预测，虽未涉及三维结构或动态机制，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The transforming growth factor beta-1 (TGF beta-1) cytokine exerts both pro-tumor and anti-tumor effects in carcinogenesis. An increasing body of literature suggests that TGF beta-1 signaling outcome is partially dependent on the regulatory targets of downstream receptor-regulated Smad (R-Smad) proteins Smad2 and Smad3. However, the lack of Smad-specific antibodies for ChIP-seq hinders convenient identification of Smad-specific binding sites. RESULTS: In this study, we use localization and affinity purification (LAP) tags to identify Smad-specific binding sites in a cancer cell line. Using ChIP-seq data obtained from LAP-tagged Smad proteins, we develop a convolutional neural network with long-short term memory (CNN-LSTM) as a deep learning approach to classify a pool of Smad-bound sites as being Smad2- or Smad3-bound. Our data showed that this approach is able to accurately classify Smad2- versus Smad3-bound sites. We use our model to dissect the role of each R-Smad in the progression of breast cancer using a previously published dataset. CONCLUSIONS: Our results suggests that deep learning approaches can be used to dissect binding site specificity of closely related transcription factors.
abstract_zh: 背景：转化生长因子β-1（TGF beta-1）细胞因子在致癌过程中兼具促肿瘤和抗肿瘤作用。越来越多的文献表明，TGF beta-1信号传导的结果部分依赖于下游受体调节型Smad（R-Smad）蛋白Smad2和Smad3的调控靶点。然而，缺乏用于ChIP-seq的Smad特异性抗体阻碍了Smad特异性结合位点的便捷识别。结果：在本研究中，我们使用定位和亲和纯化（LAP）标签来识别癌细胞系中的Smad特异性结合位点。利用从LAP标记的Smad蛋白获得的ChIP-seq数据，我们开发了一种具有长短期记忆的卷积神经网络（CNN-LSTM）作为深度学习方法，将Smad结合位点池分类为Smad2或Smad3结合位点。我们的数据表明，该方法能够准确分类Smad2与Smad3结合位点。我们使用该模型，通过先前发表的数据集，剖析每个R-Smad在乳腺癌进展中的作用。结论：我们的结果表明，深度学习方法可用于解析密切相关转录因子的结合位点特异性。
